title: Reported speech
about: she said that…, he asked if…, they told me to…

entries.note: После said настоящее время обычно сдвигается в прошлое: am → was.

entries.en: “I’ve lost my wallet.” → He said he [had lost|lose] his wallet.
“I’ll call you.” → She promised she [would call|call] me.
“I can help.” → He said he [could|can] help.

choice: She told me she was leaving.
She said me she was leaving.
entries.note: tell somebody, но say (to somebody). said me — ошибка.

choice: He said that he was busy.
He told that he was busy.
entries.note: Без адресата — say; tell требует, кому сказали: He told me…

entries.en: “Are you hungry?” → She asked me [if I was/whether I was|if / I / be] hungry.
entries.note: Вопрос да/нет → if / whether + прямой порядок слов.

entries.en: “Where do you live?” → He asked me where I [lived|live].
entries.note: В косвенном вопросе нет do/does и прямой порядок: where I lived.

choice: She asked me what time it was.
She asked me what time was it.
entries.note: Косвенный вопрос — порядок слов как в утверждении.

entries.en: “Close the door, please.” → She asked me [to close|close] the door.
entries.note: Просьба / приказ → ask / tell somebody to do.

entries.en: “Don’t be late.” → He told us [not to be|not / be] late.
entries.note: Отрицательная команда → tell somebody not to do.

entries.en: “I live in Omsk.” → She told me she [lives/lived|live] in Omsk.
entries.ru: Она сказала мне, что живёт в Омске.
entries.note: Если это всё ещё правда, время можно не сдвигать.

entries.en: “I saw him yesterday.” → She said she had seen him [the day before/the previous day|yesterday].
entries.ru: Она сказала, что видела его накануне.
entries.note: yesterday → the day before / the previous day; tomorrow → the next day.

choice: He suggested going to the cinema.
He suggested to go to the cinema.
entries.note: suggest + -ing или suggest that…; suggest to do — ошибка.

entries.en: “I’ll drive you to the station.” → He offered [to drive|drive] me to the station.
entries.ru: Он предложил подвезти меня до вокзала.
entries.note: offer to do — предложить сделать самому.

entries.en: “I didn’t take the money!” → She denied [taking|take] the money.
“Don’t touch the dog.” → He warned me [not to touch|not / touch] the dog.
entries.ru: Он предупредил меня, чтобы я не трогал собаку.

entries.en: “Sorry I’m late.” → She apologised [for being|for / be] late.
“Have you finished?” → The teacher wanted to know [whether we had finished/if we had finished|whether / we / finish].
entries.ru: Учитель хотел знать, закончили ли мы.
